verdict.rationale: The official Python SDK lists CorporateCards ('Create virtual and/or physical cards') and CorporateHolders ('Manage cardholders'), so card issuance runs through the same API as the account. The marketing site claims 'full spending control, flexible limits' for physical and virtual cards, but the evidence does not document these controls as API features. missing for 10: digital wallet support (Apple/Google Pay provisioning), documented API-level spend controls/limits, confirmation the cards are debit cards tied to the account balance, in-depth card API reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
